sourceSupportedFacts: Dhika sees the knee-length skirt John had previously asked her to wear to Aunty's house.
She recalls that she had avoided it there because it felt disrespectful in front of Uncle and now thinks it might unknowingly have given Uncle thoughts about her.
Today she wants to wear the skirt and wonders whether Chotu would like it and think she looks beautiful; she feels shy.
After second thoughts she wears the skirt with a sleeveless, non-deep-cut top leaving a slight gap between skirt and top.
She explicitly does not want cleavage visible because she is unsure herself and unsure how Chotu feels.
She notices a very small amount of stomach visible and does not mind it.
She does not realize that raising her hands would lift the top and reveal more stomach.
She applies a little mascara and rose lipstick and is described as looking stunning.
